g.desc: USB-C supply powers the UNO Q separately. Do not connect HVAC R/C to the electronics supply.
Match each net name to the board header named in ../pinout.csv.
Harness connectors below describe interface order, not UNO Q package pin numbers.
Use an approved 3.3V source. If external, join SELV grounds; do not backfeed the board rail.
Never parallel a factory safety interlock. Normally-open wiring cannot detect a broken lead.
One effective pullup per line; omit these if module pullups already provide the correct load.
100kHz / short local bus. Breakout connector pin order must be verified before wiring.
